title: scan_col_v inserted mid-comment orphans measure_color_run's doc block
detail: The comment block now heading scan_col_v opens with measure_color_run's contract ('screen column x', 'found=false'), leaving measure_color_run with no adjacent doc and scan_col_v's doc headed by another proc's description.
recommended_fix: Move the scan_col_v insertion below measure_color_run (or restore measure_color_run's three doc lines directly above it), so each proc's doc comment sits immediately above its own declaration per project convention.
